gpu_policy: Finish the active 10000-step geometry run unchanged; never stop GPU; serial trials.

workstreams.question: Does geometric supervision improve decoded geometry beyond further feature training?

experiments.action: Use the feature-best checkpoint as the common initial state.
Feature-only continuation from G0 using the unchanged predecessor code

workstreams.intervention: Zero only points/mask/scale/gradient/normal loss weights in G2.
readouts: point-derived geometry versus independent normal-head loss
paired per-scene differences with bootstrap uncertainty
workstreams.interpretation: G1 vs G0 measures before/after change; G1 vs G2 tests geometric supervision conditional on this training seed. Teacher agreement and sensor ground-truth accuracy are distinct claims.
conditional_improvements: If scale remains dominant, compare a log-metric-scale objective with the current scale objective, holding the adapter and other terms fixed.
If point-derived shape stagnates while normal-head loss falls, compare point/depth-derived shape supervision with the independent-normal objective.
Investigate differentiability and units before adding any loss through focal/shift postprocessing; oracle teacher substitutions are diagnostics, not deployable gains.

workstreams.question: Does the broader data mixture improve transfer without losing indoor geometry?
workstreams.sampling: Uniform scenes within a selected source, then uniform frames; COCO image IDs do not verify physical-scene independence.
workstreams.split_policy: NYU1043train/116val/290test remain isolated. COCO40000train/256val/256test selected before inference. Check paths, source provenance, exact hashes and known scene groups; exact hashes do not rule out near duplicates.
workstreams.interpretation: The causal intervention is the broader mixture plus its sampling allocation, not image count alone. Report each source and equal-source aggregate; COCO RGB distillation has no sensor depth ground truth.
workstreams.further_data_gate: Use source-specific validation failures to choose further licensed metric-depth or geometric domains; do not keep adding similar frames merely to increase counts.

workstreams.question: Does a spatial head improve results with the data and budget fixed?

experiments.architecture: Four-scale reassembly and residual spatial convolution; spatial summary readout
Two1280-wide16-head transformer blocks and spatial summary readout

readouts: geometry-stage gain relative to own feature best
parameters, step time and peak memory
workstreams.limitations: Equal updates/examples, not equal FLOPs or convergence. DPT and attention change inductive bias as well as capacity; this is not a parameter-count-only experiment.
workstreams.decision_gate: If a candidate shows a coherent improvement beyond scene-level uncertainty, confirm baseline and candidate with additional seeds at a common budget. If error patterns suggest a frozen-representation bottleneck, separately test LoRA on upper RADIO blocks with the chosen head, data and losses fixed. Neither follow-up is automatically launched.

selection.policy: Report RMSE and all last checkpoints without changing selection after seeing results.

evaluation_policy: Use internal validation for selection and diagnosis. The existing20 NYU test scenes have already been inspected and are a fixed qualitative audit, not a fresh blind test. Keep remaining test evaluation separate from tuning; include NYU sensor-depth scores and new COCO test teacher agreement with their respective limitations.
